invariants.rationale: The method always returns a new Label instance using the constructor, so result is never null.
The Label is constructed with the given style, so calling getStyle() on result returns the same style instance.
The Label is constructed with the parameter text, so getText() on result equals the text argument.
Passing a null style to the Label constructor would likely cause a NullPointerException; style is expected to be non-null.
Similarly, the text argument should be non-null to avoid potential issues; the Label is constructed directly with it.
